# FairRentWize

> US Fair Market Rents & Rental Affordability Data

Explore HUD Fair Market Rents for 3,000+ US counties and 400 metro areas. Compare rental costs, calculate affordability, and find rent burden data by location.

## Core pages
- [Methodology and data sources](https://fairrentwize.com/methodology/): how every figure is derived, with primary-source citations
- [Rankings](https://fairrentwize.com/rankings/): county ranked by the key metric
- [About and editorial standards](https://fairrentwize.com/about/): authorship and review policy

## Data
- Primary sources: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, U.S. Census Bureau, National Low Income Housing Coalition
- All figures are derived from these primary sources; see /methodology/ for derivation and vintage.
